evidence.observation: Initial ~12 °C overshoot above 750 setpoint decayed smoothly to setpoint by t≈2700 s; controller behavior consistent with normal settling.
Brief pressure excursion to ~3.2-3.24 Torr for 4 samples, then returned to ~2.99 Torr; transient only.
Cooldown ramp to 200 sccm with pressure ~4.0 Torr and heater at 0%, as expected.
Exhaust O2 stable 2-7 ppm throughout; no leak signature.
